header.description: AUTHORED FOR causalab-mini — not copied from causalab, in the same way documents/das_cpu_reduction.json is not. No shipped causalab document in documents/ taps a `.source` interior at all, so the three copied ones cannot exercise one; this is the fourth, and the only one whose site is reached inside a module's forward rather than at its boundary. Method: minimal_cpu.json's interchange skeleton, unchanged except for the site — one swap at the last prompt token of layer 0 of the same tiny random Llama, on CPU in fp32 — with `attention_query` in place of `block_output`. `attention_query` is the query tensor as the attention implementation receives it: after the projection, after the head reshape, after RoPE, at the call that hands it to whichever kernel the checkpoint runs. It is addressed by that call, not by the name of a variable the forward happens to assign. One write, one scored read, one metric. The second read, `v_cf`, is not an extra: a `swap` operand may only be a read name, so an interchange write always has one.
header.title: attention_query interchange, tiny Llama, CPU
